title: Rabbi Yehoshua bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael cites this name from Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4, which has Rabbi Chama, father of Rabbi Yehoshaya. Hyman calls this an error, comparing Peah 8:8, which has Rabbi Chama, father of Rabbi Oshaya. Hyman refers to his Nachmani entry, where he proposes Nachmani, father of Rabbi Oshaya, and identifies him as Rabbah’s father.

notes.text: Maamar means the cited statement, not an unidentified book. Hyman’s proposed Nachmani/Oshaya relationship and identification as Rabbah’s father remain his cross-entry argument.
The consulted Peah 8:8 reads Chama, father of Oshaya. Hyman’s Nachmani reconstruction and identification with Rabbah’s father remain his argument; neither is adopted as a new genealogical finding.
